title: Exact colors with reversible drafts
summary: Enter precise RGBA bytes or hex colors for text, callouts and new-image drafts, with explicit Apply and Cancel.

Added: Exact Red, Green, Blue and Alpha byte controls plus six/eight-digit hex input in a shared color popup.
A draft preview, optional palette, input validation and explicit Apply/Cancel. Clicking outside discards the draft.
Scrollable color controls keep Apply and Cancel reachable when the palette is expanded.
Fixed: Numeric color edits preserve the requested channels through zero opacity, saving and reopening. One committed annotation color change occupies one Undo step.
Palette initialization keeps RGB separate from alpha, avoiding the lossy premultiplied initialization path.
Verified: Native exact text hex/byte edits, zero-alpha restoration, invalid input, cancellation, one-step Undo/Redo and all 256000 clipboard pixels.
Independent callout fill and outline values, text-dialog draft cancellation, and New Image color Apply/outside cancellation.

limitations: Screen capture, global hotkeys, rich text styles and complete reference-interface parity remain unfinished.
This is an original ClipCraft exact-color workflow; broader color-picker interactions remain under review. Interactive palette conversion and all keyboard interactions remain under review.
The default opaque drawing-tool color picker still uses its existing control; this popup covers text, callout fill/outline and New Image RGBA controls.
Native Save As/export-dialog inspection remains blocked separately. Existing-path saves, shared PNG exports and native clipboard comparisons are verified.
